note: sub-rects are arithmetic: col = i % cols, row = (i / cols)|0. MICRO cells are centre-cropped squares; THUMB cells contain the tile at its own aspect, centred (see fit). micro.tiles[].i IS the corpus index; a thumb tile's corpus index is sheet * thumb.perSheet + i. Ids repeat (a scene is sampled at several seconds) — key on the corpus index, never the id.
